parse_qwen3xml_tool_calls: parse streaming XML tool call chunks from a Qwen3 model output and return extracted DeltaMessage responses
extract_qwen3xml_tool_calls: extract structured tool calls from a complete Qwen3 XML model output string using the Qwen3XMLToolParser
stream_qwen3xml_tool_calls: stream incremental Qwen3 XML delta text and return real-time DeltaMessage with tool call arguments
reset_qwen3xml_parser_state: reset the StreamingXMLToolCallParser internal state to prepare for a new parsing session
convert_qwen3xml_param_types: convert streaming parameter values to their correct Python types based on tool schema definitions
